result.topic_en: Calculation of instrument corrections (azimuth/level-type constants A, B, m, p) for three marked points a, b, c in a sketched room or observatory plan, followed by longitudes of Hamburg and Hohenkirchen.

methods.what: Instrument correction expressed both as a combination of cosine and sine of an angle and in terms of collimation-type constants m, n, p with tangent and secant of declination
methods.quote: $\mathrm{Corr} = A\cos z + B\sin z \quad = m\,\mathrm{tg}\,\delta + n\sec\delta + p$

methods.what: Linear expression of z in terms of coordinates x, y with coefficients A, B scaled by 8.663
Linear transformation (rotation) giving A and B from p and m
Corrections at points a, b, c as linear combinations of A and B, then evaluated numerically with A = 15.14, B = 10.67
